scope: Curated creative AI research: 3D Gaussian splatting, video, voice, diffusion and efficient generation. No robotics or physical AI.

papers.title: ViRDM: can a faster video model keep the motion?
papers.summary: Post-trains an existing few-step causal video generator against cached real-video feature distributions, with dynamics regularization to constrain motion.
papers.caveat: Fresh technical report; author-reported results. Teacher-free here does not mean no pretrained encoders. The reported compute covers post-training, not building a generator from scratch.
papers.review_depth: Primary abstract and method verification; no reproduction

papers.title: FlashRender: fewer steps, but keep the camera move.
papers.summary: Connects camera-control inconsistency to discretization. Combines geometry-aligned representations, MeanFlow and distillation for few-step video retakes.
papers.caveat: Earlier this month, not a release this week. Author-reported camera-controlled rendering results; the linked lab illustrates a numerical mechanism and does not reproduce the model.
papers.review_depth: Primary abstract and method verification; no reproduction

papers.title: LACI: recover when long narration drifts.
papers.summary: An inference-time method detects errors, rolls back and temporarily constrains generation in long-form text-to-speech.
papers.caveat: Early evidence on specified TTS systems. Worst-of-N error rates and sliding-window speaker similarity measure different failure modes.
papers.review_depth: Abstract and submission history; no reproduction

papers.title: StepAudio 3 Gen: one discrete audio vocabulary.
papers.summary: A shared residual-quantization representation supports speech, voice design and other audio generation tasks with autoregressive modeling.
papers.caveat: Technical report. SOTA is the authors’ claim on selected tasks; no independent listening test or reproduction here.
papers.review_depth: Abstract and submission history; no reproduction

papers.title: BEACON: identity is not expression.
papers.summary: Reference images provide appearance; reference video supplies facial behavior. Separate conditioning addresses an important gap in subject-specific video generation.
papers.caveat: Preprint evaluated on MEAD and RAVDESS. Do not extrapolate facial-expression results to complete film or multi-shot consistency.
papers.review_depth: Abstract and submission history; no reproduction

papers.title: VS-Splat: put splats where the object is.
papers.summary: Select object-relevant voxels before allocating Gaussian primitives for sparse-view reconstruction.
papers.caveat: Author-reported benchmark comparisons. Not a general winner for every scene, camera setup or capture workflow.
papers.review_depth: Abstract and submission history; no reproduction

papers.title: Learn which context to keep.
papers.summary: Elastic Threshold Attention learns contextual thresholds for block-sparse decoding. Its latest abstract reports up to 2.15× end-to-end speedup over FlashAttention-2.
papers.caveat: Author-reported, 1.45B model, contexts up to 512K. Do not substitute older v1 claims or interpret this as a universal speedup.
papers.review_depth: Versioned abstract and submission history; no reproduction

papers.title: Parallel tokens are not free.
papers.summary: A theoretical comparison separates masked, uniform and Gaussian language diffusion under specific distribution and score-oracle assumptions.
papers.caveat: Theory preprint. Forward-pass complexity is not a production wall-clock benchmark or a universal ranking of deployed models.
papers.review_depth: Abstract and submission history; proofs not independently checked
